name: listOrders
description: List every order on the desk with its customer, item, amount and status.

description: Attach an internal note to an order. Does not move any money.

description: Refund an order. Call it with `simulate: true` first to surface what would be refunded; run the bare call only in a LATER turn, after their message carries the confirmation code.
